messages.content: Four travellers must cross a bridge at night with one torch. At most two cross at a time and a pair moves at the slower person's pace. They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes. What is the fastest total crossing time, and what is the schedule?

This is the classic bridge and torch puzzle with crossing times of 1, 2, 5, and 10 minutes, and I recall the optimal solution takes 17 minutes. I'm working out the sequence: send 1 and 2 across together, have 1 return, send 5 and 10 across …[5648 chars]

**The fastest total time is 17 minutes.** **Schedule** | Step | Action | Time | Running total | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 1 and 2 cross together | 2 | 2 | | 2 | 1 walks back with the torch | 1 | 3 | | 3 | 5 and 10 cross together | 10 | 13 | |…[1057 chars]
